# Disposable verification target

This project is generated by the adjacent fixture script. Tests and probes are
opt-in where they intentionally fail, sleep, write artifacts, or exercise
isolation boundaries.

The browser smoke can run from the Verity module when Node.js, Playwright, and
its Chromium browser are available. For an isolated setup, install them in a
temporary prefix, then set `NODE_PATH`, `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI`, and
`VERITY_FIXTURE_PLAYWRIGHT=1` while running
`go test ./internal/verification -run TestExecutionIntegrityFixtureGenerator`.
The browser check is intentionally separate from the default Go suite.
